description: Get the changes/diffs of a merge request (merge_request_iid or source_branch required). To find resources, use the matching list or search tool. Read-only; missing resources, denied access, and rate limits return errors. `project_id`/`group_id` take a numeric ID or URL-encoded path.

excluded_file_patterns.description: Array of regex patterns to exclude files from the diff results. Each pattern is a JavaScript-compatible regular expression that matches file paths to ignore. Examples: ["^vendor/", "^test/mocks/", "\.spec\.ts$", "package-lock\.json"]

jmespath.description: Optional JMESPath expression filtering the JSON result before return.

merge_request_iid.description: The IID of a merge request

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project

name: get_merge_request_diffs
